Recorded claim:
The host already owns `role=radio`, `aria-checked`, form value, keyboard selection, and roving tabindex. The shadow template displays text but does not automatically name the host; `#updateAccessibleName()` normalizes complete `this.textContent`, so slot listeners recompute title, tag, and description together. [Task 1] [ad-hoc note]
